title: Detekcija i odgovor na incidente (detection lab)
subtitle_en: Phase 4 of the plan: logs (Linux, CloudTrail, Kubernetes audit), Wazuh SIEM (rules, decoders, FIM, active response), Sigma and MITRE ATT&CK, Falco, attack simulation (Atomic Red Team) and incident response according to NIST SP 800-61r3, using a real Wazuh and real attacks in an offline lab.
subtitle: Faza 4 plana: logovi (Linux, CloudTrail, Kubernetes audit), Wazuh SIEM (pravila, dekoderi, FIM, active response), Sigma i MITRE ATT&CK, Falco, simulacija napada (Atomic Red Team) i odgovor na incidente po NIST SP 800-61r3, kroz pravi Wazuh i stvarne napade u labu, bez interneta.

exam.note: Za detection lab nema zvaničnog ispita: rezultat su tvoje detekcije i runbookovi (modul „Capstone“). Ova simulacija je samoprovjera. Sljedeći korak u planu je Microsoft SC-200 (Sentinel, Defender XDR, KQL), a opcionalno CompTIA CySA+.
exam.note_en: There is no official exam for the detection lab: the outcome is your detections and runbooks (the "Capstone" module). This simulation is a self-assessment. The next step in the plan is Microsoft SC-200 (Sentinel, Defender XDR, KQL), and optionally CompTIA CySA+.

objectives.en: Linux logs: syslog/auth.log, journald, auditd; formats, time zones, log integrity
objectives.bs: Linux logovi: syslog/auth.log, journald, auditd; formati, vremenske zone, integritet logova

objectives.en: Cloud and Kubernetes logs: CloudTrail, Azure Activity and Entra sign-in logs, Kubernetes audit
objectives.bs: Cloud i Kubernetes logovi: CloudTrail, Azure Activity i Entra sign-in, Kubernetes audit

objectives.en: Collection and normalization: agents, syslog forwarding, schemas (ECS, OCSF), retention
objectives.bs: Prikupljanje i normalizacija: agenti, syslog forwarding, šeme (ECS, OCSF), retencija

objectives.en: Wazuh architecture: agent, manager, indexer, dashboard; ruleset, alert levels, alerts.json
objectives.bs: Arhitektura Wazuha: agent, manager, indexer, dashboard; ruleset, nivoi alarma, alerts.json

objectives.en: Wazuh decoders and rules: custom decoders, rule correlation (frequency, if_matched_sid), wazuh-logtest
objectives.bs: Wazuh dekoderi i pravila: vlastiti dekoderi, korelacija (frequency, if_matched_sid), wazuh-logtest

objectives.en: File integrity monitoring, configuration assessment (SCA), vulnerability detection
objectives.bs: Praćenje integriteta fajlova (FIM), procjena konfiguracije (SCA), otkrivanje ranjivosti

objectives.en: Active response: automatic containment and its risks
objectives.bs: Active response: automatsko obuzdavanje i njegovi rizici

objectives.en: MITRE ATT&CK: mapping detections, coverage, ATT&CK Navigator layers
objectives.bs: MITRE ATT&CK: mapiranje detekcija, pokrivenost, ATT&CK Navigator slojevi

objectives.en: Sigma rules: logsource, detection, modifiers, conditions; conversion to SIEM queries with pipelines
objectives.bs: Sigma pravila: logsource, detection, modifikatori, uslovi; konverzija u SIEM upite uz pipeline

objectives.en: Detection lifecycle: testing, false positives, tuning, detection as code, pyramid of pain
objectives.bs: Životni ciklus detekcije: testiranje, lažni pozitivi, podešavanje, detection as code, piramida bola

objectives.en: Runtime detection with Falco: rules, macros, lists, exceptions, outputs
objectives.bs: Runtime detekcija sa Falcom: pravila, makroi, liste, izuzeci, izlazi

objectives.en: Investigating AWS activity from CloudTrail: compromised credentials, persistence, defense evasion
objectives.bs: Istraga AWS aktivnosti iz CloudTraila: kompromitovani kredencijali, perzistencija, izbjegavanje odbrane

objectives.en: Investigating Kubernetes audit logs: token abuse, exec, privileged workloads, secrets access
objectives.bs: Istraga Kubernetes audit logova: zloupotreba tokena, exec, privilegovana opterećenja, pristup tajnama

objectives.en: Adversary emulation: Atomic Red Team, Stratus Red Team, MITRE Caldera; purple teaming
objectives.bs: Emulacija napadača: Atomic Red Team, Stratus Red Team, MITRE Caldera; purple teaming

objectives.en: Incident response frameworks: NIST SP 800-61r3 and CSF 2.0, roles, playbooks vs runbooks
objectives.bs: Okviri za odgovor na incidente: NIST SP 800-61r3 i CSF 2.0, uloge, playbook i runbook

objectives.en: Triage and evidence collection: order of volatility, chain of custody, Linux live response
objectives.bs: Trijaža i prikupljanje dokaza: redoslijed volatilnosti, lanac nadzora, Linux live response

objectives.en: Containment, eradication and recovery for hosts, containers and cloud accounts
objectives.bs: Obuzdavanje, iskorjenjivanje i oporavak za hostove, kontejnere i cloud naloge

objectives.en: Runbooks for common incidents: leaked keys/tokens, cryptominers, exposed storage; post-incident review
objectives.bs: Runbookovi za česte incidente: procurjeli ključevi/tokeni, kriptomineri, izložen storage; analiza nakon incidenta
